title: Houston Building Atlas Data Ecosystem & Provenance Catalog
subtitle: Declarative registry of all 29 municipal, county, state, federal, academic, and archival institutions (46 data feeds) with quantitative universe coverage, Pass-1 vs. Pass-2 extraction fidelity audits, and gap-closure playbooks
maintenanceNote: Add or update any institution or data feed in this JSON file (app/public/data/data_sources_catalog.json). Both the interactive screen explorer and the printable 24x36 architectural blueprint poster in app/data-ecosystem.html render automatically from this catalog.

statusDefinitions.label: Active Automated Feed
statusDefinitions.description: Fetched and cross-checked automatically by scheduled GitHub Actions pipelines (daily 7:00 AM CT sweeps, biweekly agenda builds, or annual roll refreshers) or live browser REST queries.

statusDefinitions.label: Active Curated / Archival Corpus
statusDefinitions.description: Digitized, geocoded, and indexed into the production Atlas shards from archival books, directories, historic maps, and preservation surveys.

statusDefinitions.label: Assisted Staff Cross-Check (1-Click Portal)
statusDefinitions.description: Integrated into the 15-Point Watchlist and Property Drawer with pre-filled search terms and one-click clipboard copy for portals gated by session tokens or CAPTCHAs.

statusDefinitions.label: In-Flight Public Records / Archive Order
statusDefinitions.description: Formal archival reproduction order or Texas Public Information Act (TPIA) bulk request submitted; parser and schema ready for ingestion upon delivery.

statusDefinitions.label: Not Used Yet (Planned Roadmap)
statusDefinitions.description: Identified high-value institutional dataset not yet ingested into the app, with a concrete technical plan and target milestone for integration.

frequencyBuckets.label: Daily 7:00 AM CT Automated Sweep
frequencyBuckets.description: Queried every morning at 7:00 AM Central Time via GitHub Actions to detect new demolition permits, sewer disconnects, asbestos notices, HCAD ownership transfers, and HAHC filings.

frequencyBuckets.label: Biweekly Planning Commission Cycle
frequencyBuckets.description: Ingested every two weeks ahead of and following City of Houston Planning Commission meetings (Plat Tracker spreadsheets, Section K variances, agenda outlines, and post-meeting minutes).

frequencyBuckets.label: Monthly / Live Browser GIS Query
frequencyBuckets.description: Refreshed monthly via bulk exports or queried live in the browser when inspecting a parcel on the map or Watchlist.

frequencyBuckets.label: Quarterly & Annual Certified Roll
frequencyBuckets.description: Synchronized with HCAD's annual certified appraisal roll (July/August) with October/November correction supplements, plus quarterly state/federal historic registry updates.

frequencyBuckets.label: Indexed Archival & Historic Corpus
frequencyBuckets.description: Multi-decade historical datasets (1866-1959 City Directories, 1905-1951 HMRC Building Permits, Sanborn Maps, and architectural surveys) indexed into static lookup shards.

frequencyBuckets.label: On-Demand Staff Cross-Check (HITL)
frequencyBuckets.description: Pre-formatted one-click search pills in the 15-Point Watchlist that copy target addresses, HCAD IDs, or LLC names for immediate lookup in session-gated portals.

frequencyBuckets.label: In-Flight Orders & Planned Ingestion
frequencyBuckets.description: Datasets currently being acquired via Harris County Archives reproduction orders, TPIA bulk requests, or scheduled Phase 2-4 pipeline expansions.

synthesisEngines.name: Construction Date Integrity & Rounding Override Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Detects HCAD placeholder decade defaults (1900, 1920, 1930, 1940, 1950) and cross-checks City Directories, HMRC building permits, Sanborn maps, and Harris County Archives tax rolls to establish verified construction years.

synthesisEngines.name: 6-Tier Ownership Unmasking & Chain-of-Title Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Builds multi-decade ownership chains (2005-2026 HCAD certified rolls + Clerk deeds), unmasks Texas Tax Code Sec. 25.025 Current Owner shields, and links shell LLCs across portfolios using mailing addresses and Texas Comptroller / SOS officer records.

synthesisEngines.name: 8-Agency Daily Demolition & Early-Warning Sweep Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Runs daily at 7:00 AM CT across COH structural demo permits, water/wastewater disconnects, DSHS asbestos abatement notices, HAHC COA filings, HCAD deeds, and Dangerous Building hearing orders, enforcing Two-Key confirmation before graduating buildings to Lost Houston.

synthesisEngines.name: Biweekly Subdivision Plat Triage & Cross-Cycle Continuity Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Cross-checks biweekly Planning Commission Plat Tracker spreadsheets, Agenda Outline PDFs (including Section K Development Plat Variances), and Post-Meeting Minutes against pre-1976 buildings, historic districts, and watched developers, consolidating repeat filings across cycles.

synthesisEngines.name: Resident Genealogy, Contractor & Sanborn Evolution Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Links 39 Houston City Directory volumes (1866-1959) via dual pass (Street Guide + Alphabetical Resident Directory) with 1905-1951 HMRC building permits, historic street renumbering (1911), and Sanborn Fire Insurance Map footprints.

synthesisEngines.name: Landmark, Historic District & Preservation Status Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Reconciles City of Houston Protected Landmarks, City Landmarks, 22 local Historic Districts, National Register (NRHP) properties, Recorded Texas Historic Landmarks (RTHL), and Good Brick Award winners to determine legal demolition protection vs. unprotected risk.

deepDiveSpotlights.institution: HPL / HMRC ContentDM + Ancestry Collection 2469 + Rice Fondren Microfiche
deepDiveSpotlights.headlineMetric: 51,798 HCAD parcels matched (+3,649 Pass-2 pre-1927 cached-page parcels, 3,631 extended pre-1927 parcels) vs. ~185,000 pre-1968 Houston addresses
deepDiveSpotlights.summary: We have cataloged 67 of the 78 target directory editions from 1866 to 1968 (39 pre-1927 HPL volumes + 28 distinct post-1926 Ancestry years across 31 volume entries, leaving 11 un-digitized 1931-1963 microfiche gap years). Pass-2 local re-extraction across all 6,576 cached pre-1927 HPL pages and 273,677 post-1926 Ancestry sightings matched 51,798 HCAD parcels (+3,649 Pass-2 pre-1927 cached-page parcels, raising continuous pre-1927 + post-1926 parcel timelines from 2,350 to 3,631) and cross-checked Street Guide initials against Alphabetical occupations.
deepDiveSpotlights.whyPass1MissedData: Three specific fidelity bottlenecks reduced Pass-1 yield on already-scanned volumes: (1) In the 15 post-1926 Street & Avenue Guide volumes (where we scanned 100% of the 2,652 Street Guide pages at step=1), long streets spanning multiple columns or page turns frequently omit a repeated bold street header at the top of continuation columns, causing OCR line parsers to drop ~35-42% of householder lines until the next printed street header; (2) In the 23 post-1926 Alphabetical Resident (A-Z) volumes (11,479 total pages), Pass 1 sampled every 4th to 18th spread (1,699 spreads = 14.8% of Alphabetical pages) and skipped 1957 (133 pages); and (3) In the 39 pre-1927 HPL volumes (1866-1926), Pass 1 ran targeted phrase queries for 7,541 historic-core addresses rather than dumping all ~28,000 pages, and pre-1911 directories use pre-ordinance house numbers before Houston's 1911-1912 street renumbering.
deepDiveSpotlights.howWeWillFillGaps: Four-part Pass-2 execution plan: (Pass 2A) Re-parse all 2,652 cached Street Guide pages with a sequential page-to-page column-header state machine + VLM layout segmentation to recover ~85,000+ dropped continuation-column listings, plus retain '1/2' rear garage apartments and commercial tenants; (Pass 2B) Sweep the remaining 9,780 post-1926 Alphabetical A-Z pages on Ancestry (dbId=2469) at step=1 (especially alphabetical-only years 1937, 1946, 1948, 1951, 1953, 1955, 1957, 1958, 1959, 1968) to recover ~120,000+ additional household heads and spouses; (Pass 2C) Execute a full-page dmGetItemInfo OCR dump across all ~28,000 pages of the 39 HPL 1866-1926 volumes paired with the 1911-1912 Directory Old-to-New Street Number crosswalk table; and (Pass 2D) Digitize the 11 missing public-domain editions (1931, 1933, 1938, 1943, 1944, 1947, 1950, 1960, 1961, 1962, 1963 - 100% USCO cleared with 0 renewals) from open-stacks microfiche Call No. F394 .H8 P62 at Rice Fondren Library Kelley Center.

deepDiveSpotlights.title: 2. Harris County Clerk Real Property & Plats (1823-2026): 7.68 GiB Local TPIA Dump vs. Pass-2 Deep Linkage
deepDiveSpotlights.institution: Harris County Clerk Data Sales (7.68 GiB Custom Order #6816066) & Historical Deed Books
deepDiveSpotlights.headlineMetric: 678,467 of 799,168 target 1960-2026 instruments matched (84.9%, +48,701 in Pass 2) across 152,464 parcels; 2,655 / 5,573 plats calibrated
deepDiveSpotlights.summary: We have 100% of the Harris County Clerk's machine-readable Real Property Index from Nov 1, 1960 to Nov 13, 2026 (RPIInstruments.txt 1.64 GiB, RPLegalDesc.txt 1.18 GiB, RPNames.txt 4.47 GiB, RPRelDoc.txt 391 MiB) and 100% of the Maps & Condos Index from 1823 to 2026 (58,722 rows) on local disk. With Pass-2 13-column RPLegalDesc.txt parsing (Unit, Tract, OutLot, Reserve, Comment, Misc), subdivision abbreviation canonicalization (FST->FOREST, FMS->FARMS, HTS->HEIGHTS, VLG->VILLAGE), L12 TO 18 B39 comment range expansion, and Two-Wave RPRelDoc.txt graph propagation, Tier 1 matched 292,599 exact file numbers and Tier 2 matched 385,868 legal descriptions (678,467 total = 84.9% linkage rate, +48,701 newly linked instruments, updating +5,868 owner_history and +21,990 permits accounts).
deepDiveSpotlights.whyPass1MissedData: Four conservative Pass-1 filters left recoverable data inside the local 7.68 GiB files: (1) To keep permits_*.json.gz at 73.4 MiB inside GitHub Pages' 980 MiB limit, Tier 2 legal-description matching (SubDivision + Section + Block + Lot) was scoped to 188,200 pre-1945/landmark/confidential target HCAD accounts rather than all 1,239,007 countywide accounts; (2) When a historic single-family lot (e.g., Lot 1, Block 12) was later replatted into >4 townhome parcels (Lots 1A..1F), max_parcels_per_legal_key=4 skipped attaching the pre-replat 1960s-1990s deeds; (3) ~95,000 older Clerk rows store lot/block tokens ('L23-24 B4') or metes-and-bounds tract names inside the free-text Comment column of RPLegalDesc.txt rather than structured Lot/Block columns, or use abbreviated subdivision strings ('HGTS', 'NORHILL ADDN') that differed from HCAD lgl_2; and (4) RPRelDoc.txt (391 MiB linking releases of mechanic's liens and mortgage assignments back to parent instruments) was not traversed in Pass 1.
deepDiveSpotlights.howWeWillFillGaps: Four-part Pass-2 execution plan on local disk + archival deed books: (Pass 2A) Parse 'L<N> B<M>' and 'TR <N>' tokens from RPLegalDesc.txt Comment and apply a fuzzy Clerk-to-HCAD subdivision synonym dictionary across all 5,573 subdivisions (raising plat calibration from 2,606 [46.8%] to >5,000 [90%+]); (Pass 2B) Propagate pre-replat historical deeds (where Clerk FileDate < HCAD replat year) onto all child townhome accounts on a subdivided lot, bypassing the 4-parcel ambiguity cap for pre-split dates; (Pass 2C) Traverse RPRelDoc.txt (391 MiB) so Release of Lien filings lacking a legal description inherit the parcel match of their parent Mechanic's Lien or Deed of Trust; and (Pass 2D) Digitize/OCR the pre-1960 General Index to Deeds (1836-1960 Grantor/Grantee ledgers at Harris County Archives / Clerk) to bridge 1836-1960 conveyances.

deepDiveSpotlights.institution: Houston Architecture Info Forum (HAIF via Wayback CDX & Invision CDN)
deepDiveSpotlights.headlineMetric: 29,467 / 29,467 threads crawled (100%); 5,598 threads linked to 4,032 HCAD/building keys & 6,264 street addresses (+62 NRHP links, +199 photos -> 538 total)
deepDiveSpotlights.summary: We crawled 100% of the 29,467 unique HAIF topic threads across 97 subforums via the Internet Archive Wayback Machine CDX API. Pass-2 hyphenated range slug parsing, speedway/esplanade street matching, title/excerpt architect extraction, and NRHP landmark cross-linking expanded haif_index.json to 5,598 threads across 4,032 HCAD/building keys and 6,264 street addresses (including 62 NRHP listings, 116 COH Landmarks, 142 Good Brick Awards, 531 curated overrides, and 538 total building photos).
deepDiveSpotlights.whyPass1MissedData: Topic URL slugs on HAIF only contain an explicit street address when a moderator titled the thread '<Project Name> At <Address>'. Older historic threads in '23-historic-houston', '36-houston-mod', and '78-architects-developers-builders-and-designs' use titles like 'Abandoned Mid-Century Bank On Ost' or 'John Staub House In Broadacres', where the exact street address, archival clipping, and media.invisioncic.com image URLs appear inside the discussion posts.
deepDiveSpotlights.howWeWillFillGaps: (Pass 2A Complete - Range Slug, Architect & NRHP Cross-Linker) Expanded slug address extraction to hyphenated address ranges and speedways, extracted architect credits across titles/excerpts, and linked 62 NRHP listings and +27 additional direct Invision CDN photos (538 total in building_photos.json); (Pass 2B - Multi-Page Post-Body Mining) Parse post bodies across the remaining unlinked Historic Houston and Houston Mod threads to recover post-body-only street addresses and Lost Houston teardown photos.

deepDiveSpotlights.title: 8. HCAD Appraisal Rolls & Permits (1988-2026): 100% Post-2005 Coverage vs. 1988-2004 Server-Conversion Gap
deepDiveSpotlights.institution: Harris Central Appraisal District (HCAD PDATA, Open Records & ArcGIS)
deepDiveSpotlights.headlineMetric: 1,507,897 / 1,507,897 footprints dated (100%); 22 / 22 annual rolls (2005-2026, 1,239,007 accounts) ingested; 1988-2004 bridged via Clerk TPIA
deepDiveSpotlights.summary: We have ingested 100% of HCAD's surviving digital CAMA certified appraisal rolls (22 annual editions from 2005 through 2026 across 1,239,007 accounts in 152 gzipped shards), 100% of HCAD's 1,300,027 permit rows and 914,980 appraiser inspection notes, and resolved 100.00% of Harris County's 1,507,897 building footprints to a verified or inferred year (0 undated). For 1988-2004, HCAD Open Records confirmed on Nov 11, 2026 that pre-2005 CAMA tables were lost during agency server conversions.
deepDiveSpotlights.whyPass1MissedData: (1) HCAD 1988-2004 Server-Conversion Loss: HCAD no longer holds 1988-2004 electronic CAMA snapshots, and 89,970 pre-1988 accounts carry a default '01/02/1988' acquisition date from when HCAD digitized 1983 Tax Assessor microfilm rolls; (2) Rounded-Decade Placeholders: 3,047 Historic Core parcels in HCAD still carry un-overridden rounded decade estimates (1920, 1930, 1940) where HCAD appraisers estimated age after 1984 computerization.
deepDiveSpotlights.howWeWillFillGaps: (1) Because HCAD lost its 1988-2004 electronic tables, we bypass that gap directly by combining the 1960-2004 Harris County Clerk TPIA deed index (already on local disk!) with the 1915-1997 Harris County Archives CR001 Block Books and 1970-1983 CR067 Microfilm Tax Rolls; (2) The remaining 3,047 Historic Core rounded-decade estimates (c. 1920/1930) are queued in Historical_Audit_Queue for automated calibration via Pass-2 City Directory, Sanborn footprint, and CR001 Block Book value-jump cross-checks.

corpusCompletenessSummary.keyTakeaway: Across all 46 institutional data feeds (29 institutions), the Atlas has achieved 84% average source-universe acquisition coverage but 67% average parcel-level extraction fidelity. 13 feeds already have raw scans, bulk SQL tables, or XML finding aids on local disk or online where a targeted Pass-2 deep re-extraction (without waiting on new external orders) can unlock hundreds of thousands of additional resident listings, pre-2004 deeds, historic building footprints, and architect attributions, while 5 catalog-indexed feeds have exact box/page/microfiche call numbers ready for physical or portal pulls.
